meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以搜索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先按关键词搜出带 ID 的索引,再看某条记录前后的时间线上下文,最后只对筛出的 ID 取完整记录。
howto.when: 当你问「这个问题以前解决过吗」「上次我们是怎么做的」等关于过往会话的问题时触发;当前对话里的问题不走它。

say.text: 搜一下之前有没有修过认证相关的问题
say.note: 返回带 ID 的索引列表,每条约 50-100 tokens

say.text: 看看 #11131 前后发生了什么
say.note: 返回该条前后交错的时间线条目

say.text: 把 #11131 和 #10942 的完整记录取出来
say.note: 批量取完整记录,一次请求代替多次

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can search claude-mem's cross-session memory: a keyword search returns an index with IDs, a timeline shows context around a hit, and full details are fetched only for the IDs you filter.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about past sessions, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?"; questions about the current conversation don't use it.

say_en.text: Search whether we already fixed anything about auth
say_en.note: Returns an index with IDs, ~50-100 tokens each
Returns timeline items near that ID
